headline: On-premise clinical agent paper reports consistency-gated selective autonomy in retrospective diagnostic simulations
summary: A Nature Medicine paper reports a fully on-premise clinical diagnostic agent with a behavioral-consistency measure used to select cases for autonomous handling in retrospective simulations. On 551 MIRA-v2 cases, the authors report that a 0.90 consistency threshold retained 49.4% of cases at 98.9% diagnostic accuracy (272 retained cases, three errors); the measured accuracy reflects a constructed MIMIC-IV-derived benchmark, not prospective clinical outcomes.
